sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: SRD guidance for falls and dangerous-speed collisions.
When: Use when a fall or collision is a real consequence already established in the fiction.
Not When: Do not spring it as surprise punishment; make lethal stakes clear before the action resolves.
Question: How much damage is the fall?
Answer: Use the SRD fall/collision guide and scale it to the range, speed, and established danger.
Example: A fall from a ritual platform is damage only if the table already understands the drop is dangerous.
Aliases: falling fall damage collision crash dangerous speed
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
